scope: Processing of personal data in Vietnam and of Vietnamese data subjects, incl. foreign entities
applies_to: Domestic and foreign organisations, agencies and individuals processing personal data
key_requirements: Consent (explicit for sensitive data); processing and transfer impact assessments (DPIA/TIA); designate DPO/department; cross-border transfer rules
data_categories: Basic and sensitive personal data (e.g. health, biometric, genetic, location)
retention_period: Art. 3 principles: data stored only for period consistent with processing purpose unless law provides otherwise; delete/de-identify when purpose ends
enforcement_authority: Department of Cybersecurity and High-Tech Crime Prevention (A05) - Ministry of Public Security
penalties_range: Up to 5% of prior-year revenue (cross-border violations); up to 10x illegal gain (data trading); up to VND 3 billion other
exemptions: Micro-enterprises/household businesses exempt from DPO and DPIA; 5-year grace for small firms/startups (not if sensitive data, data services or >=100k subjects)
deceased_data: Unclear: Decree 356/2025 lists date of death as personal data, but law does not settle post-mortem protection or who may exercise rights (unconfirmed)
notes: Law 91/2025/QH15 replaces Decree 13/2023; guided by Decree 356/2025; sanctions decree 330/2026 from 2026-08-19
